scope: independent root audit of the local valuation identity, progression-count denominator bound, Archimedean height estimate, actual-selector support separation, scope, capacity, and zero booking

checks.canonical_format_repair: two missing TeX multiplication spaces repaired in the displayed numerator-height bound

mathematical_audit.local_identity: For a finite rational sum S and lambda=max_r max(0,-v_q(rho_r)), Z=q^lambda S is q-integral and -v_q(S)=lambda-v_q(Z). Reduction therefore gives v_q(E)=max(0,lambda-v_q(Z)) and v_q(g)=v_q(D)-v_q(E) exactly.
mathematical_audit.lcm_bound: For q at least 5, both linear progressions have unit step modulo q^a. Two length-r unit-step progressions each meet a residue class floor(r/q^a) or ceil(r/q^a) times, so their counts differ by at most one. Summing over q^a up to 4h+3 bounds each denominator defect by floor(log_q(4h+3)).
mathematical_audit.height: The relevant denominator factors have distinct positive absolute values when 3 does not divide h, so each r-prefix product is at least r!. Combining this with the kernel coefficient bound and the lcm denominator theorem gives log|N_x|,log|N_u|=O(h).
mathematical_audit.selector_invisibility: Every primitive-gcd prime divides the displayed clearing denominator and is at most 4h+3, while p=4h+6s+3 is at least 4h+9 for every actual row. Primitive reduction is therefore multiplication by a p-unit and preserves both selected-prime divisibility events.
mathematical_audit.scope_warning: The O(h) bound is pointwise and sums to only O(M^2) across O(M) rows. It is neither an o(M) exceptional-mass theorem nor a cross-row moving-modulus theorem.
mathematical_audit.capacity: The fixed-j=1 shared ceiling remains 1/36; no lower-bound booking or capacity reduction follows.
